create.name: Jett Psaris
create.bio:
Jett Psaris is a writer and guide who treats intimate relationships and the middle years of life as paths of inner and spiritual growth. She came to this work by an unusual route. After studying foreign service at Georgetown, she led sales and marketing at an early Silicon Valley computer start-up, then lost her fortune when it failed, paid off her debts and took an MBA. At thirty-two she stepped away for a year to question every belief she held, and from that inquiry grew a self-directed doctorate in psychology and a partnership with Marlena Lyons.

Together they founded the Conscious Living Center in the San Francisco Bay Area in 1990 and wrote Undefended Love, which treats conflict between partners as a chance to drop old defences and meet each other openly. Her later book, Hidden Blessings, reads the upheaval of midlife as a spiritual rebirth rather than a crisis to be endured, and won several independent book awards. She expanded it into Taking the Midlife Leap, a self-paced course of fourteen downloadable modules with meditations and writing practices. For more than three decades she has also worked with individuals and couples, now by phone and Zoom, and has led workshops in the United States and abroad.

books.title: Hidden Blessings: Midlife Crisis as a Spiritual Awakening
books.author: Jett Psaris
books.description: Her guide to the midlife passage as a time when an old sense of self falls away and a more soulful one can emerge, mixing psychological insight with spiritual practice.

books.title: Undefended Love
books.author: Jett Psaris and Marlena S. Lyons
books.description: Written with Marlena Lyons, a book on using the friction of a close relationship to notice and lay down emotional defences, with case stories, self-inquiries and exercises.

courses.title: Taking the Midlife Leap, One Step at a Time (full course)
courses.description: A self-paced online course in fourteen PDF modules, an introduction, twelve stages and a closing, extending Hidden Blessings with meditations, contemplative practices and writing assignments for each stage of midlife.

courses.title: Sessions with Jett Psaris
courses.description: Ongoing or as-needed sessions for individuals and couples by phone or Zoom, using her self-inquiry approach that joins Western psychology with Eastern spiritual traditions. Booked by email.

free_resources.title: Hidden Blessings Self-Inquiry Study Guide
free_resources.description: A free PDF study guide of self-inquiry questions to use alongside Hidden Blessings.
